title: Adaptive stacking and interaction resilience for cost dashboards and rollout modals
creator: Morgan Reyes
description: Design deliverable to create resilient responsive rules and interaction polish for cost views, rollout pages, and modal flows. Goals are to ensure predictable table and chart wrapping across narrow viewports, prevent modal overflow with layered content (tooltips, confirmations), and reduce jank on Safari/Edge while preserving density options for power users.
acceptance_criteria: Tables on the Cost Breakdown page collapse to a single-column summary at <=720px while preserving sorting and row actions via an overflow menu
Rollout detail view keeps primary controls sticky and secondary controls collapse into a contextual action sheet under 840px
Chart canvases gracefully fallback to a compressed sparkline with accessible summary when horizontal space is constrained
Modals never cause the page to double-scroll; stacked overlays show clear z-order and escape key/overlay click behavior is consistent across Chromium, WebKit, and Edge
Prototype validated in Chrome, Firefox, Safari (desktop & iPadOS) and Edge with documented CSS fallbacks and runtime polyfills
tasks: Audit existing cost, rollout and dashboard pages to catalog element width breakpoints and overflow patterns
Produce two interactive Figma prototypes: narrow/tablet and dense-desktop variants
Add CSS/JS polyfill recommendations and a minimal demo bundle for QA to run cross-browser tests
Sync with frontend engineering on sticky headers/anchor behavior and action menu accessibility
Run assisted QA pass and capture browser-specific visual diffs for regression tracking

review_feedback: Ethan Cole: Approve direction if engineering implements a debounced 32ms scroll handler or uses IntersectionObserver to avoid layout thrash
Priya Nair: Request that collapsed-table rows include a single-line summary and a clear CTA to expand to full row
Lina Hart (design manager): Suggest visual emphasis for critical cost deltas when space is constrained (use color+icon, not solely text)
decisions: Use an action-sheet pattern for per-row actions below 720px instead of inline icons to prevent horizontal overflow
Fallback chart strategy: show compressed sparkline + accessible numeric summary for widths under 560px
Modal stacking: implement explicit stacking context with dimming + topmost focus trap; avoid nested modal opens where possible
